findings.initial_assumption: Each recipient needs an independent damage timer
findings.correction: Native timer mapping is per effect; alias DoTs keep one active owner, phase and ordered recipient union

findings.initial_assumption: Canonical label routing alone can attach an old target to a reappearance
findings.correction: Full native world calls drop_enemies after death notices; the periodic witness applies that same lifecycle operation. Shared generation checks protect old captured receivers

findings.initial_assumption: An empty retained recipient set has no subsequent events
findings.correction: Native damage handler still emits a logical hit and named notification; shared retained ticks preserve them without landing damage
Native coefficient scaling requires explicit scaling:stack_count; stack lifetime and coefficient remain separate

findings.initial_assumption: Name identity zero means no name
findings.correction: Zero is a valid first name identity; a separate named policy bit carries presence

findings.initial_assumption: A periodic refresh ending at time 1 must use expiry nudge at that time
findings.correction: Refresh extends expiry beyond 1, so a tick at 1 is observed as 1 rather than .9999; handwritten packet times were corrected before GPU execution

findings.initial_assumption: Native clock token is stable across ordinary timer consumption
findings.correction: TimerRegistry advances to a new token when committing a new deadline. Ownership during child callbacks is checked against that committed token; phase is established from deadlines and packets, not token equality across ticks

findings.initial_assumption: Weighted amount is zero for a logical packet with no receiver
findings.correction: Native HitEvent still has its original amount; observer records that potential per-receiver amount while the empty target list contributes zero damage

findings.initial_assumption: Named group target registration can use inherited body notification context
findings.correction: The native manager resolves target by logical aim at carrier registration. A 29th case reproduces the intended ordered union; shared capture now uses that logical selector

scope: Design corrections established from native source and independent runtime observations; no existing numeric expectation was loosened to accept GPU output

initial_focused_readback.scope: Initial 25-case stage, not an additional current regression run
